title: WORMHOLE -- stereo spectral-style effects chain: warp, shift, dual reverb, blend

sections.heading: USING IT
lines: DELAY L / R: delays each channel by up to 500 ms. Different values widen the stereo image.
WARP Depth / Poles / Tilt: allpass warping that smears and colors the spectrum.
SHIFT Pitch: +/-48 semitones. FShift: frequency shift, +/-4000 Hz.
SHIFT Mode: Smooth, Tight, Det A or Det B (L/R detune). Decay: shortens ringing.
REV PRE Mix / Size / Damp: reverb before the blend stage.
BLEND: dry/effect amount. Mode: XFade (plain crossfade) or Morph (effect follows dry envelope).
REV POST Mix / Size / Damp: reverb on the final blended signal.
A dial only sends its value once it is moved. Until then the built-in default is used.

sections.heading: AS A BPATCHER
lines: Inlets: audio L and R. Outlets: processed audio L and R.
It opens in presentation, so it shows as a control panel when loaded as a bpatcher.
See wormhole-test.maxpat: input selector, this bpatcher and an output gain.
The dry signal travels by send~ wormhole_dry_L / _R, so use one instance per Max session.

sections.heading: HOW IT WORKS
lines: Six gen~ stages in series: delay > warp > shift > reverb pre > blend > reverb post.
The pitch shifter uses two crossfading delay reads. The frequency shifter uses a Hilbert transform.
Each reverb is an 8-line feedback delay network with randomly modulated delay lengths.
